newsitem.title: RUSSIA: ATHLETICS-MASTERKOVA TO MISS WORLD INDOOR CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-MASTERKOVA TO MISS WORLD INDOOR CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Double Olympic gold medallist Svetlana Masterkova will miss next month's world indoor championships, Russian selectors said on Sunday when they named a 42-strong party to travel to Paris.
Masterkova, winner of the 800 and 1,500 metres in Atlanta, is still in need of rest after last year's hectic season.
The team for the March 7-9 meeting in France was chosen after a lacklustre national indoor championships in the southern city of Volgograd this weekend.
Olympic champion Maxim Tarasov's 5.80 metres in the pole vault was the high point of the event, which a number of top athletes were allowed to miss without jeopardising their places.

Among those absent was indoor sprint specialist Irina Privalova, who ran a year's best 7.02 seconds over 60 metres at Lievin, France, last Sunday. She has her sights on both that distance and the 200 metres in Paris.
Olympic triple-jump silver medallist Inna Lasovskaya also skipped the meeting but will travel to France.
Russian Athletics Federation general secretary Vadim Zelichenok said last week the Russian team was quite capable of taking second place in Paris and winning three or four golds.
